skills.scan_codewhale_only.label: Scan CodeWhale Skills Only
skills.scan_codewhale_only.help: When set to true, ignores cross-tool root directories like .claude/skills, .opencode/skills, .cursor/skills, ~/.agents/skills, etc.

memory.enabled.label: Enable Memory
memory.enabled.help: When enabled, the TUI loads the memory file into the <user_memory> prompt block, enabling # foo quick capture and the remember tool.

snapshots.enabled.label: Enable Snapshots
snapshots.enabled.help: Creates side-git snapshots for file modifications, supporting rollback. Snapshots are stored in ~/.codewhale/snapshots/..., never using the workspace's own .git.

verifier.enabled.label: Enable Verifier
verifier.enabled.help: When enabled, automatically runs a verifier preview check when the model claims a task is complete.

snapshots.max_age_days.label: Snapshot Max Age (Days)
snapshots.max_age_days.help: Snapshots older than this many days are automatically cleaned up.

verifier.verdict_policy.label: Verifier Verdict Policy
verifier.verdict_policy.help: Currently the only policy. Maps the verifier's pass/partial/fail to hunted/wounded/escaped semantics. Unknown values are rejected, reserving extension for future policies.

skills_dir.label: Skills Directory
skills_dir.help: Each skill is a directory containing SKILL.md. Workspace-local .agents/skills or ./skills take precedence over global directories.

mcp_config_path.label: MCP Config File Path
mcp_config_path.help: MCP server configuration file path. Can be viewed with /mcp in the TUI; after modification, the TUI must be restarted to rebuild the tool pool.

notes_path.label: Notes File Path
notes_path.help: Note file path used by the note tool visible to the model.

memory_path.label: Memory File Path
memory_path.help: User memory file path. memory_path is a top-level field, not nested under [memory].
